propositions.justification: orders.create_order() acquires db.connection_pool and also synchronously calls auth.verify, inventory.reserve, and payment.charge; slow downstream work can hold pool connections and exhaust the pool under concurrent POST /orders.
propositions.predicted_signal: Active connections at pool maximum and increased waiting/timeouts on POST /orders during high concurrency or downstream latency.

propositions.justification: orders.create_order() calls auth.verify() synchronously; if auth verification is unavailable or times out, the order creation path cannot complete.
propositions.predicted_signal: POST /orders 5xx/timeouts correlated with auth verify failures or elevated auth response times.

propositions.justification: orders.create_order() calls inventory.reserve() synchronously; if inventory reservation is unavailable or times out, order creation cannot complete.
propositions.predicted_signal: POST /orders failures correlated with inventory reserve errors or elevated inventory reserve response times.

propositions.justification: orders.create_order() calls payment.charge() synchronously; if payment charging is unavailable or times out, order creation cannot complete.
propositions.predicted_signal: POST /orders failures correlated with payment charge errors or elevated payment response times.

propositions.justification: orders.create_order() calls payment.charge(); if charge times out or fails transiently, the caller may retry the order flow without an explicit backoff edge, repeatedly re-invoking payment.charge().
propositions.predicted_signal: Repeated payment charge calls for the same order/payment key within a short interval during payment latency.

propositions.justification: orders.create_order() calls inventory.reserve(); if reservation times out or fails transiently, retries of the order flow can repeatedly invoke inventory.reserve() without a backoff edge.
propositions.predicted_signal: Repeated inventory reserve calls for the same order/item within a short interval during inventory latency.

propositions.justification: orders.create_order() calls auth.verify(); if verification times out or fails transiently, retries of the order flow can repeatedly invoke auth.verify() without a backoff edge.
propositions.predicted_signal: Repeated auth verify calls from orders for the same user/session within a short interval during auth latency.

propositions.justification: orders.create_order() uses db.session; if order-related lookups or inserts depend on unindexed foreign keys, the create path can trigger full scans or per-row follow-up queries.
propositions.predicted_signal: High rows examined per order creation and query count scaling with related order data.

propositions.justification: orders.list_orders() reads through db.session and exposes a paginated collection endpoint; if page/offset boundaries are applied inconsistently, adjacent pages can overlap or skip records.
propositions.predicted_signal: Duplicate or missing order IDs at page boundaries and total count not matching concatenated pages.

propositions.justification: orders.list_orders() uses db.connection_pool; large page sizes or slow list queries hold pool connections longer.
propositions.predicted_signal: Pool wait time and active connections rise with GET /orders page size or request rate.

propositions.justification: orders.list_orders() queries via db.session; absent indexes on filters or order-by clauses, or per-order related fetches, can cause full scans or N+1 query patterns.
propositions.predicted_signal: DB rows examined and query count grow with returned order count.

propositions.justification: orders.get_order() acquires db.connection_pool; repeated or slow single-order lookups can exhaust the pool.
propositions.predicted_signal: Pool saturation during bursts of GET /orders/{order_id} or DB latency.

propositions.justification: orders.get_order() queries db.session by order_id; if order_id or related joins are unindexed, lookup scans or N+1 fetches occur.
propositions.predicted_signal: High rows examined per order lookup and latency increasing with order table size.

propositions.justification: payment.charge_payment() invokes payment.check_idempotency(); if the idempotency check and charge commit are not one atomic operation, concurrent identical charge requests can both pass the check.
propositions.predicted_signal: Duplicate charge records or unique-key violations for the same idempotency key under concurrent POST /payment/charge.

propositions.justification: payment.charge_payment() uses db.connection_pool while the charge path also invokes check_idempotency, which has its own DB session/pool edges; concurrent charges can hold multiple pool connections.
propositions.predicted_signal: Active payment DB connections at pool maximum and charge latency/timeouts under concurrent load.

propositions.justification: payment.check_idempotency() queries db.session; without an index on the idempotency key, each charge performs a scan.
propositions.predicted_signal: Slow idempotency checks and high rows examined per POST /payment/charge.

propositions.justification: payment.check_idempotency() also acquires db.connection_pool; high charge volume can exhaust the pool during idempotency lookups before the charge executes.
propositions.predicted_signal: Pool waiters during the idempotency-check phase of POST /payment/charge.

propositions.justification: inventory.reserve_stock() uses db.connection_pool; concurrent reservations with row locks or slow updates can hold connections.
propositions.predicted_signal: Inventory pool saturation and reserve latency during high concurrency.

propositions.justification: inventory.reserve_stock() checks and updates stock via db.session; if the check-and-decrement is not atomic and idempotent, concurrent identical reservations can double-reserve.
propositions.predicted_signal: Stock decremented more than once for the same reservation key or oversell under concurrent reserve requests.

propositions.justification: inventory.reserve_stock() accesses db.session by item_id; without an index on item_id the reservation lookup or update scans.
propositions.predicted_signal: High rows examined per reserve and latency increasing with inventory table size.
